d: Department: Rooms Division, Front Office & Guest Services

The Director of Operations – Rooms serves as the executive steward of the overall guest arrival-to-departure journey and the physical condition of the resort. Leading a diverse division encompassing 283 luxury keys, Housekeeping & Laundry, Front Office, Safety & Security, and Spa & Recreation, this leader is responsible for setting luxury service benchmarks, driving rooms-related ancillary revenues, optimizing operational margins, and maintaining pristine asset presentation and comprehensive safety standards
q: Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive luxury hospitality management experience, with at least 3–5 years as Director of Rooms or Director of Operations in a recognized 5-star international luxury hotel or resort.
Comprehensive Scope: Proven experience managing multi-departmental operations including Housekeeping, Front Office, Spa/Recreation, and Security within a resort environment.
Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline; Master’s or relevant executive management credentials preferred.

Technical Proficiency: Deep working knowledge of Property Management Systems (e.g., Opera Cloud, Micros), Spa Management systems (e.g., Book4Time), guest service platforms, and modern revenue management tools.
Certifications: Health & Safety management certifications (OSHA, IOSH, or local equivalents), First Aid/CPR leadership awareness; luxury brand service auditor certification advantageous.
Competencies: Strong strategic planning and financial analysis skills, crisis management composure, operational resilience, and an eye for physical detail and cleanliness.
r: Architect and lead the end-to-end guest journey, from pre-arrival concierge outreach and curbside VIP welcomes to seamless check-out and post-stay loyalty engagement.

Establish and audit standard operating procedures (SOPs) aligned with ultra-luxury benchmarks (e.g., Forbes Travel Guide, Leading Hotels of the World), ensuring flawless delivery across all touchpoints.
